einzeiler: Debra Roberts and Aaron Katersky answer listener questions in a bonus Q&A.
kurzfassung: Debra Roberts and Aaron Katersky host a subscriber bonus Q&A session, discussing professional advice and memorable career moments. They share insights on journalism, including lessons learned from mentors like Barbara Walters and David Muir. The conversation also features a retrospective on reporting trips, such as an Emmy-winning reunion story in Ethiopia.
stichpunkte: Debra Roberts and Aaron Katersky host the first monthly Q&A session for subscribers of the show.
Roberts shares that Barbara Walters taught her the value of outlasting detractors in a high-pressure industry.
Katersky notes that David Muir's core reporting mantra for World News Tonight is to simply get straight to the point.
Roberts recalls a memorable assignment traveling to Ethiopia shortly after the birth of her daughter.
The Ethiopian reporting trip followed a young woman seeking her birth mother without modern GPS or social media.
The emotional reunion in the remote Ethiopian village ultimately earned an Emmy Award.
Both journalists reflect on the unpredictable nature of field reporting and the privilege of telling impactful human stories.
